What is your full legal name as it appears on your legal documents?

conversation.speaker: PATIENT
conversation.message: Mostly it’s been at work — I’ve been floundering there and can’t seem to get moving on a pretty simple project. I’m also having a hard time concentrating, and I just don’t really see a future for myself right now.

conversation.message: I’m sorry you’re dealing with this. When you say you don’t really see a future for yourself, is this something you’re experiencing right now, and are you currently able to stay safe?

conversation.message: I’m hoping it helps me get unstuck, I guess. I mean, it’s mostly about being able to move forward again — is that what you mean?
